label: Week 32, 2026
recap:
This was a quiet week for United States AI policy activity. Four bills saw status changes, most of them at the federal level, with the United States Congress accounting for three of the tracked bills and California accounting for one. Among the themes present, health care appeared once, tied to United States Congress HB10024, and both infrastructure and energy and transparency and disclosure appeared once each, both linked to United States Congress HR1471. Two bills in the dataset were not tied to any theme.
